sources.title: GLM-5.2 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Copy Models GLM-5.2 - How to Run Locally Run the new GLM-5.2 model by Z.ai on local hardware! GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's new open model, delivering SOTA performance across long-horizon coding, reasoning, and agentic tasks. With 744B parameters, 40B active parameters, and a 1M context window, it can now be run locally using Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs.
